cross_fit.rule: a dataset and question type with at most max_folds scenes is cross-fitted leave one scene out (calibration: leave two out); with more, its scenes are grouped into max_folds folds balanced by row count and the same scheme runs on folds (calibration scores for a test scene come from scenes outside its fold, predicted without both folds)

fold_groups.rule: for each dataset in config.fold_groups, every question type is cross-fitted with one fold per group (measured_space.audit.scene_folds), ignoring max_folds: a group's scenes are predicted by a model fitted without the group, and calibrated by the scenes of the other groups, each predicted without both groups; the inner ridge search and the scene-cluster bootstrap stay by scene; assignment in folds.csv
